title: Do not count a pinned formula as a failed Homebrew upgrade
notes: With mysql pinned, 'brew upgrade --formula mysql' exits non-zero ('Not upgrading 1 pinned package') and the homebrew plugin reported 'Homebrew items failed: mysql' on every run (office Mac, 2026-11-24). list_brew_outdated should leave pinned formulae out, or the plugin should report them as a note.
done_when: A run with a pinned outdated formula ends with the homebrew plugin successful and the pin reported as a note
result: Do not count a pinned formula as a failed Homebrew upgrade
evidence: update_homebrew reads brew list --pinned and reports a pinned formula as a note; tests/plugins/homebrew-pinned-foreign-cask.sh GREEN, RED without the change ('Homebrew items failed: heldformula')
